brief.t: START HERE: Open the TALOVA fulfillment record, then call Production to confirm whether the requested 500 lip balms can ship and obtain proof of delivery for the earlier 15,000 units.

ACT NOW 1: TALOVA reported a stockout and requested another 500 lip balms, while delivery of the earlier 15,000 units remained unverified. Marcello is waiting. The request is 1 calendar day old, and no completion is visible in the available sources. Send: I am checking delivery proof for the 15,000 and our stock and build timing for the 500 now, and I will confirm the next ship date today.

ACT NOW 2: Solabia is waiting for confirmation that PLL's bill-to address should change to 24600 N. Industrial Dr. before the 6 kg Estogel Max PO can move cleanly. A firm ship date is still missing, and the remaining 14 kg path is unverified. The reply is 1 calendar day old with no stated deadline. Send: Please update our bill-to address to 24600 N. Industrial Dr., confirm receipt of the 6 kg PO, and send the earliest firm ship date.

ACT NOW 3: Polo container TR#47618 was scheduled for pickup October 9 with no holds reported, but pickup and release remain unconfirmed. Dispatch is waiting on closure. The scheduled pickup is 1 calendar day overdue unless completed. Send: Please confirm TR#47618 was picked up and released yesterday, or send the new appointment time and current blocker.

next: Recommendation: Close TALOVA first because the customer is already out of stock, then remove the Estogel address and ship-date blockers.
Scheduled: 5 email-derived milestones. The nearest is Jedwards shipment 384100536855, estimated for delivery October 12 between 10:30 AM and 2:30 PM.

Source gaps: CRM and WhatsApp browser sessions are signed out. Purchasing has no current source records to verify open supplier, QC, inventory, or lead-time risks. The Email lane reports the Proteger agreement response is 6 calendar days overdue and belongs to Sam's lane. Missing data is not zero.
signal: TALOVA fulfillment remains unverified after a reported stockout. Solabia needs the corrected PLL bill-to address and has not supplied a firm Estogel Max ship date. Polo container pickup remains unconfirmed.
redflags: TALOVA's requested 500-unit replenishment and proof of delivery for 15,000 prior units remain unverified.
The Estogel Max 6 kg PO lacks a firm ship date, and the remaining 14 kg supply path is unverified.
CRM and WhatsApp could not be scanned because both browser sessions are signed out.
noise: 50 unique inbound Outlook messages arrived in the exact window; 33 were unread and 40 were noise.
